NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A couple asks for the wedding garlands to be woven in a new pattern of their own: weave it, or use the old pattern.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) are getting married, and the wedding garlands on Isola have always been woven in two patterns, one for each partner's family. Both of their families use the same pattern. They would like a new one, just for them. (subject)'s aunt, who weaves the garlands, is not sure. What should happen?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The aunt grumbles and then spends a week inventing a new pattern: two vines twisted around each other. It is beautiful. After the wedding, three other couples ask for it. The aunt is very pleased with herself.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The aunt weaves two garlands in the family pattern, identical. (subject) and (friend) decide that this is perfect too: two of the same, which is what they are. They wear them for days afterwards.
